about: Names people search for that a station page does not carry (docs/DECISIONS.md 0032). Each entry is pinned to the station's display name; when that changes, the entry stops applying and tests/test_site.py fails. 'name' leads the page's title and H1, place first. 'query' is the Search Console query (28 days to 2026-11-11) that shows the name is searched for; 'basis' is what ties the name to the station.
